commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: If it is someone’s nature to spread the faults of people close to them behind their backs, what will they do to strangers? To spread is to make many people know, and nothing is crueller than that. Some read என்னர்கொல், “what sort of people are they?”
